name: openkt
description: OpenKT (Open Knowledge Transfer) — persistent memory layer for Codex agents. SessionStart + UserPromptSubmit hooks. Bring the kt CLI to drive auth + project binding.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent memory + standing context for Codex
interface.longDescription: OpenKT captures decisions, anti-patterns, and non-obvious project facts across sessions, then auto-injects the most relevant ones into every prompt via SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit hooks. Works alongside the kt CLI for authentication and project binding.
